resources.string: A free and open-source language app that feels approachable like Duolingo, but is grounded in real didactics and tested learning methods. Learn at your own pace — offline-first, private, and ad-free.
E.g. physiotherapist: I want to speak with patients and colleagues in German
Tell OpenLingo who you are and what you want to learn. This helps tailor examples, exercises, lessons and vocabulary to you. You can change it anytime.
Optionally connect a provider and add your API key. Without a key, OpenLingo remains fully usable: offline content, review and exercises all keep working.
Each profile keeps its progress, settings and study path separate.
